disclaimer: Evidence-based partial audits, not complete 13-criterion scorecards. Do not assign or publish a V5.2 score until missing items are checked. Official company pages establish their stated terms, not independently verified payout execution.

evidence.finding: FTMO expressly permits removal of simulated trades, disqualification, forfeiture of potential rewards, and termination for forbidden trading practices. Need full signed FTMO Account Agreement to assess procedural safeguards and actual B1 score.
evidence.consequence: A trader may lose an otherwise expected reward after a violation finding.

evidence.finding: Some practices are objective (more than 2000 server requests/day); others use open-ended replicability and risk-management standards, such as substantially different position sizing and excessive exposure. Flag interpretive risk, not a confirmed abusive denial.
evidence.consequence: A compliant-looking trading strategy may be reviewed under qualitative risk standards.

evidence.finding: FTMO states reward request on day 14 or later after first trade; account review 1-2 business days, transfer typically 1-2 business days after invoice approval; 1-Step and Instant 90%, 2-Step 80% with potential increase to 90%.
evidence.consequence: Traders must distinguish request eligibility, review and actual transfer, and program-specific splits.

missing: Full FTMO Account Agreement for payout disputes and appeals

evidence.finding: Topstep payout page: XFA Standard requires 5 winning days of $150+, XFA Consistency requires 3 trading days and 40% consistency. Standard/Consistency per-request cap 50% balance up to program/size-specific $2000-$6000, with optional DLL checkout double-cap promotion for eligible new purchases; LFA no dollar cap. Payout split generally 90/10 with legacy cohort exception.
evidence.consequence: Different payout conditions and dollar ceilings apply by account path and purchase cohort.

evidence.finding: After each XFA payout Maximum Loss Limit resets to $0 permanently; on XFA Standard 5-day count resets, on Consistency 3-day and consistency calculation reset. These are disclosed, objective rules and not automatically B2 discretionary deductions.
evidence.consequence: Remaining trading buffer shrinks after payout; trader must plan account risk.

evidence.finding: Topstep lists international wire estimated 5-10 business days with $30 fee; approval can take 1-3 business days; Wise no longer available November 2026.
evidence.consequence: International traders face processing fees and delays distinct from US options.
